en.name: Palm oil
en.summary: Palm oil keeps 1 year from purchase in a cool dark cupboard, and about 6 months once opened. It is mostly saturated, which makes it one of the more stable cooking fats, but the failure mode is still rancidity rather than bacteria.
en.pantry: 1 year from purchase unopened and about 6 months after opening, in a dark cupboard away from the cooker, tightly capped. Heat, light and air oxidise it; rancid oil smells of old crayons or putty and tastes bitter, and no amount of cooking removes that. Unrefined red palm oil has a useful extra clock built in: it fades from deep orange to pale yellow as its carotenes break down, so the colour tells you roughly where you are. It sets solid below about 24 °C and melts again with no harm done, so a jar that is firm in winter and liquid in summer is behaving normally. Decant a working amount into a small bottle and keep the bulk container closed, because every opening brings in fresh air. None of these figures is published for palm oil specifically — they are read across from other stable cooking fats.
en.fridge: Refrigeration slows oxidation but sets palm oil rock hard and makes it awkward to use, which is the same objection that applies to refrigerating coconut oil, and no refrigerated timeline is given here. Reach for it only if you have bought a large tin you will not finish within the year, and then scoop out a working jar for the cupboard rather than chipping at a cold tin every time you cook.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for palm oil and freezing is not useful. A fat this saturated is already among the most stable in the kitchen, so there is little for the freezer to prevent, and a frozen block is even harder to portion than a refrigerated one. If you want convenience, melt it and set it in a silicone mould, then keep the pieces in a cool cupboard.
en.thawing: Let a chilled or solid jar stand at room temperature until it softens. Never melt it over direct heat to speed things up, and never pour used frying oil back into the jar.
spoilage: A smell of old crayons or putty — rancidity, and it cannot be cooked out.
A bitter taste in anything fried in it.
Red palm oil faded from deep orange to pale yellow, meaning the carotenes have gone.
Mould or a sour smell, which only happens if water or food got into the jar.
tips: Decant a small working jar and keep the bulk tin sealed.
Use a clean dry spoon; water and crumbs are what spoil a jar of solid fat.
Judge red palm oil by colour as well as by date.
Never return used frying oil to the jar.

faq.q: How long does palm oil last?
faq.a: 1 year from purchase unopened, and about 6 months once opened, kept cool, dark and tightly capped. The figures are read across from other stable cooking fats.
Not normally. It sets rock hard and becomes awkward to use, and no refrigerated timeline is given. Only consider it for a large tin you cannot finish within the year.

faq.q: Why has my red palm oil turned pale?
faq.a: The carotenes that give it the deep orange colour have broken down with light and time. It is a fair visual indicator that the oil is past its best.

zh.name: 棕櫚油
zh.summary: 棕櫚油自購買日起未開封可放 1 年，開封後大約 6 個月，要放陰涼避光處。它大部分是飽和脂肪，算是比較穩定的食用油脂，但它的失敗方式仍然是油耗，不是細菌。
zh.pantry: 未開封自購買日起 1 年、開封後約 6 個月，放遠離爐具的陰暗櫃子，瓶蓋鎖緊。熱、光和空氣會把它氧化；油耗的油聞起來像陳年蠟筆或油灰，吃起來發苦，而且怎麼煮都去不掉。未精煉的紅棕櫚油多了一個很好用的時鐘：隨著類胡蘿蔔素分解，它會從深橘褪成淡黃，顏色大致就告訴你走到哪裡了。它大約在 24 °C 以下凝固、以上融化，完全無害，所以冬天硬、夏天液態都是正常的。請分裝一小瓶日常使用，大罐保持密封，因為每開一次就進一次新鮮空氣。這些數字都不是針對棕櫚油公布的，而是比照其他穩定食用油脂讀過來的。
zh.fridge: 冷藏能拖慢氧化，但會把棕櫚油凝得硬邦邦、非常難用——這和不建議冷藏椰子油是同一個理由，所以這裡不給冷藏期限。只有在你買了一年內用不完的大罐時才考慮；而且那時也請先挖出一小瓶放櫃子日常使用，不要每次做菜都去鑿那罐冰硬的油。
zh.freezer: 棕櫚油沒有公布的冷凍期限，冷凍也沒有用。飽和度這麼高的油脂本來就是廚房裡最穩定的之一，沒什麼需要冷凍去防；而且冷凍的油磚比冷藏的更難分份量。想要方便，就融化後倒進矽膠模定型，再把小塊收在陰涼的櫃子裡。
zh.thawing: 把冰過或凝固的罐子放室溫回軟即可。不要為了加速而直接用火融，也絕對不要把用過的炸油倒回罐子裡。
spoilage: 聞起來像陳年蠟筆或油灰——那是油耗，煮不掉。
用它炸出來的東西發苦。
紅棕櫚油從深橘褪成淡黃，表示類胡蘿蔔素已經分解。
長霉或發酸——這只會在水或食物跑進罐子時發生。
tips: 分裝一小瓶日常用，大罐保持密封。
用乾淨的乾湯匙；讓一罐固態油脂變壞的是水和碎屑。
紅棕櫚油除了看日期，也要看顏色。
絕對不要把用過的炸油倒回罐子。

faq.a: 未開封自購買日起 1 年，開封後約 6 個月，要陰涼避光、瓶蓋鎖緊。這些數字是比照其他穩定食用油脂而來。
一般不用。冷藏會讓它硬到很難用，這裡也沒有給冷藏期限。只有一年內用不完的大罐才需要考慮。

faq.q: 紅棕櫚油為什麼顏色變淡了？
faq.a: 讓它呈現深橘色的類胡蘿蔔素隨著光線和時間分解了。那是一個相當可靠的視覺指標，表示這瓶油已經過了最好的狀態。
